question_or_proposition: For cyanide discharges, does the schedule-of-compliance requirement to 'Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date' mean that the final numeric cyanide effluent limitations are enforceable for compliance comparison throughout the permit term (with the 12-month date serving only as a compliance-deadline milestone), or that those final numeric limits are not enforceable for compliance comparison until 12 months after the permit effective date?
required_context: Cyanide effluent limitation values and any interim-limit provisions specified elsewhere in the permit
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, page 6, part_i, SECTION B - SCHEDULE OF COMPLIANCE, item 1
notes: The nominated span sets a compliance achievement deadline for cyanide effluent limitations. Resolving when final numeric limits become enforceable for comparison directly affects which limit applies to reported cyanide measurements during Federal FY2025 monitoring periods.
